name: Bit
about: A little wind-up tin robot with an antenna bulb and a key in his back, drawn in storybook pencil and watercolour: the author's mascot (rigged for the web: eyes, brows, mouth, arms, a bob and a cheer).

can.viewNotes: front only: sprites the storybook plate drew once
can.faceNotes: his own eyes (open, happy, shut, blink, squint), brows (neutral, up, worried, none) and mouths (smile, grin, o, wobble, flat); angry is his squint and a flat mouth
can.poseNotes: BitPose: off, bob, squash, lean, head, look, arms (lift 0-0.8), the cheer's jump; no walk, point or sit
can.hands: n/a: mitten hands on lifted arms
can.talk: his o and smile by turns; no lip sync

sheetBy: Moworks Studio: packages/anidoodle-styles/v1 (the app's sheet film; every figure drawn by the author's engine as pinned)
